description: DAO-ENUM (T), variant: a member removed while an enumerator is live. Tables ZDn1, ZDn2 and ZDn3 are created; TableDefs is refreshed and enumerated; in the body of every Next the item Name is read and DROP TABLE ZDn3 is run (it succeeds on the first item and fails 3376 afterwards) so the dropped table is still ahead of the cursor; the later Next, Reset, Next, Skip and Clone answers and the final Count show how a stale enumerator treats the removed member.
retentionNote: Designed r-q2-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
